algorithm: OceanSim acoustic FAST-LIVO2 adaptation with absolute bathymetric terrain-map factors

algorithm_tracks.dead_reckoning_imu_dvl_depth: IMU propagation with DVL velocity and pressure depth
algorithm_tracks.local_acoustic_esikf: self-built surfel/intensity-map relative acoustic ESIKF; no prior-map correction
algorithm_tracks.online_global_slam: online pose graph including accepted loop, intensity, and absolute bathymetric terrain factors
algorithm_tracks.final_optimized_global_slam: the same global factor graph after consuming every accepted factor in a final optimization

navigation_initialization.roll_pitch_velocity_and_depth: estimated from stationary IMU, DVL, and pressure samples
navigation_initialization.horizontal_origin_and_yaw_gauge: known launch pose plus the explicitly reported deterministic capture-offset test
navigation_initialization.interpretation: bounded coarse surface-launch initialization; the matcher is not an unbounded kidnapped-vehicle global search

simulation_clock_model: exact application-clock sensor events; kinematic AUV pose; zero-order-held IMU propagation to asynchronous sonar timestamps; Isaac physics timeline is not the navigation time base

reproducibility.determinism_scope: sensor noise, event scheduling, sampling, and decimation are seeded/deterministic; bitwise identity is not claimed across Isaac, Warp, driver, device, or thread configurations

terrain_source: BathymetryB [5m] and Backscatter A/B/C/D measured mosaic

terrain_matching_reference.source_product: BathymetryB [5m] and Backscatter A/B/C/D measured mosaic

backscatter_map_matching.map_role: georeferenced side-scan texture refinement of accepted bathymetric fixes
backscatter_map_matching.source_product: BathymetryB [5m] and Backscatter A/B/C/D measured mosaic
backscatter_map_matching.radiometry: unitless normalized survey mosaic; port/starboard and smooth cross-track trends removed before zero-mean normalized correlation; not calibrated target strength
backscatter_map_matching.fusion: equal-weight covariance intersection in local SE(2) coordinates; bathymetry/backscatter independence is not assumed
backscatter_map_matching.inverse_crime_risk: optimistic same-survey texture upper bound; noise, attenuation and incidence effects are simulated, but the reference mosaic is not from an independent survey

sonar_profile.source_document: 多波束测深侧扫作业及成像V2.docx
source_ambiguities: R is not consistently distinguished as slant or ground range
250 m is not explicitly identified as per-side or full-swath width
eight along-track beams are represented here as image rows
2 cm sampling is not explicitly identified before or after slant correction

sonar_profile_interpretation.along_track_rows: modelled as eight parallel virtual footprint centres per side, spaced by the documented along-track sample interval
sonar_profile_interpretation.warning: 2 cm output sampling and 2.5 cm documented sensor resolution do not create independent centimetre-scale seabed information from the 5 m source raster

sonar_simulation_assumptions.along_track_footprint_model: parallel virtual row centres; finite 0.14 deg aperture is recorded but not coherently integrated

survey_route_definition.planner: four-neighbour A* through cardinal extrema of the largest eroded connected component
survey_route_definition.polyline_simplification: Ramer-Douglas-Peucker, 100 m tolerance, followed by finite-width U-turn replacement at four boundary extrema
survey_route_definition.smoothing: periodic Chaikin corner cutting followed by periodic Catmull-Rom interpolation

recommended_flight_profile.note: A periodic slope-limited vertical look-ahead envelope starts climbs before steep terrain; altitude therefore varies while remaining inside the 250 m sonar range.

survey_route_definition.note: The raster rectangle contains NoData. Disconnected islands cannot be reached without crossing NoData, so they are excluded from a physically valid continuous mission.

terrain_match_truth_evaluation.definition: unaligned matcher seed and output error against the synchronized simulated pose at each matcher invocation; truth is recorded only after matching for diagnosis

position_error_statistics.definition: unaligned Euclidean position error at synchronized 10 Hz acoustic ping times, including the t=0 ping/initialization sample exactly once

orientation_error_statistics.definition: truth-to-estimate relative SO(3) rotation at synchronized 10 Hz acoustic ping times, decomposed into intrinsic roll/pitch/yaw error; yaw is wrapped and no component-wise quaternion subtraction is used
